COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.

2. When learning Data Analysis and Visualisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Data Analysis and Visualisation.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester

4. When learning Cybersecurity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cybersecurity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cybersecurity.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

15. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

16. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Data Analysis and Visualisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
